purpose: Editorial discovery taxonomy audit of every distinct source commodity ID. This is not a botanical certification, a price merge, or an instruction to publish a page for every topic.
sourceScope: All crops.json and ticker.json plus crop-prices/*.json crop headers recursively under server/db/data (India, CG and individual states).
policy: Only exact normalized IDs are resolved; no substring, fuzzy, translated-name or botanical guessing.
Curated groups support article discovery. Each article must still specify applicable region, variety, crop form and stage.
Fresh/dried, grain/leaf, whole/split and processed commodities keep distinct IDs and prices even if they share an editorial topic.
No automatic article or indexable page is created from this report. Publish only substantively researched content.
Generic or ambiguous labels do not inherit crop-specific guidance until reviewed; do not fill gaps by guessing.
Medicinal, regulated and toxic crops require their own qualified editorial review before publishing use or cultivation advice.
Source Hindi labels are not used for identity matching; some legacy names are known to be inaccurate.

references.supports: Cumbu is pearl millet; used only to group exact cumbu commodity labels with bajra.
Cowpea / Lobia is also called Karamani; does not establish whether a market record is fresh or dry.

commodities.reason: Source name conflicts with observed Chirayta variety; establish crop identity before a species guide.
